audit.whatIsWrong: win[0] said Singed though its caption ends 'so it's even'; win[4] said Skill and win[5]/win[6] said Singed though every one of those captions describes Kayle out-ranging and out-DPSing him.
audit.why: The Singed-side mirror settled the chart as Skill / Singed / Singed / Singed / Kayle / Kayle / Kayle. Rows 1-3 already match; rows 0, 4, 5, 6 did not.
audit.corrected: Chart aligned to the mirror in both layers with ratings to match.

audit.why: Level 6 ranged form plus Divine Judgment, Nashor's, and his late flank threat are the right four windows.

audit.whatIsWrong: Fling was labelled his Q and Poison Trail his E — the slots are swapped everywhere. Insanity Potion's Grievous Wounds was never mentioned, and the Fling-into-Mega-Adhesive root was missing.
audit.why: Riot text: Q is Poison Trail (no cooldown, 13 mana per tick), E is Fling (125 range, 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s) and roots the target if they land in Mega Adhesive, and R Insanity Potion makes Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds.
audit.corrected: Slots corrected throughout; the root condition added to early; the anti-heal added to mid with the instruction to trade before he drinks.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect: no cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere.
audit.why: Fling is 10s at rank 1 and Mega Adhesive 17s — both long enough to step up on once spent.
audit.corrected: Fling's 10s cooldown added to the do's.

edits.before: Your Q (Radiant Blast) armor/MR shred and slow plus W sustain start to out-trade a champ whose only damage is an E poison trail you can simply walk out of.
edits.after: Your Q (Radiant Blast) resist shred and slow plus W sustain start to out-trade a champ whose only damage is Poison Trail (Q), which you can walk out of.

edits.before: Divine Ascent goes ranged and R grants a few seconds of invuln — you out-range his poison and his Q (Fling) can't catch a kiting Kayle.
edits.after: Divine Ascent goes ranged and R grants a few seconds of invuln — you out-range his poison and Fling (E), 125 range, can't reach a kiting Kayle.

edits.before: Singed has no all-in burst, so your usual death-window is harmless here — just stay out of Q (Fling) range so he can't toss you onto his E poison trail, and farm even.
edits.after: Singed has no all-in burst, so your usual death-window is harmless here — stay outside Fling (E), a 125-range flip, so he cannot toss you onto Poison Trail, and farm even.

edits.before: Singed is the rare bully who can't actually kill you early, so your nightmare level-1-to-3 window is basically off — there is no Renekton-style all-in to fear here. The whole danger is his Q (Fling): he tosses you backwards onto his E poison trail and toward his W (Mega Adhesive) slow, so never walk into Fling range to contest a CS. Stand on your own side, last-hit with Q (Radiant Blast) range, and accept he'll proxy. Do NOT chase him through the poison to punish — that's exactly the trade he wants.
edits.after: Singed is the rare bully who can't actually kill you early, so your nightmare level-1-to-3 window is basically off — there is no Renekton-style all-in to fear here. The whole danger is Fling (E), 125 range: he tosses you backwards onto Poison Trail and into Mega Adhesive, and a fling that lands you in the goo roots you outright. Stand on your own side, last-hit at Q (Radiant Blast) range, and accept he'll proxy. Do NOT chase him through the poison — that's exactly the trade he wants.

edits.before: Level 6 flips the lane hard: Divine Ascent makes your autos ranged with a small AoE wave, so you finally out-range his poison trail and his Fling can't reach a Kayle who's kiting at distance. Pop W (Celestial Blessing) for the move-speed burst to stay outside Fling range, and use Q's slow and armor/MR shred to peel him if he tries to glue-and-run-you-down with Mega Adhesive. Your R invuln also makes his Fling-into-tower or Fling-into-gank setups worthless. Once your first item lands, E's missing-HP on-hit eats his drain-tank HP bar faster than he can sustain.
edits.after: Level 6 flips the lane hard: Divine Ascent makes your autos ranged with a small AoE wave, so you out-range Poison Trail and Fling can't reach a Kayle kiting at distance. Insanity Potion (R) makes that poison apply Grievous Wounds, so it halves Celestial Blessing — take your trades before he drinks and heal back once it drops. Pop W's move-speed burst to hold spacing, and use Q's slow and resist shred to peel him off if he glues you with Mega Adhesive. Once your first item lands, E's missing-HP on-hit eats his HP bar faster than he sustains.

edits.before: Land Q (Fling) to throw you onto his E poison trail and into W (Mega Adhesive) slow, chipping you for free
edits.after: Land Fling (E) to throw you onto Poison Trail and into Mega Adhesive, where the landing roots you

edits.before: His flip. Dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: His flip, 10s at rank 1 — into Mega Adhesive it roots. Step up.

notes: Slots were swapped page-wide: Poison Trail is Q, Fling is E. Fling roots if you land in Mega Adhesive. Insanity Potion gives his poison Grievous Wounds, which halves Celestial Blessing — that was the flagged missing interaction and is now in mid.
